en: A black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a mid‑20th‑century modernist interior, likely an exhibition space about letters and mail. At the center, an elderly man and woman sit at a round table on simple wooden chairs, appearing to read or write. To the left, display stands show documents and graphics; above them hang panels with circular motifs. On the far left is a wall‑mounted mailbox. On the right, a slatted wooden partition bears the large text "VÅRA BREV." Additional text panels in the background discuss the significance of letters, in what appears to be Swedish.
